title: ODS: Test-Time Adaptation in the Presence of Open-World Data Shift

layout.note: Two stacked dashed boxes, Training Phase above Testing Phase, with the grey Model box at their left border; a long blue arrow runs along the testing box above two blue rounded segment boxes (Snowy day at left, Downtown at right) with an ellipsis between them.

lesson: Define a learning setting with two framed phases and one model box straddling them, then show the test stream as titled segments of fanned thumbnails split by a dashed line into classes whose group sizes change, so covariate and label shift are visible without drawing any method.
